# -------- Stage 1: Build the app --------
FROM node:20-bookworm AS builder

WORKDIR /app

# Disable husky hooks in CI
ENV HUSKY=0
RUN printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n' > /usr/local/bin/husky && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/husky

# Copy root manifests
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./

# Copy workspace manifests for dependency resolution
COPY shared/package.json shared/package.json
COPY shell/package.json shell/package.json
COPY mfe-fp/package.json mfe-fp/package.json
COPY mfe-kp/package.json mfe-kp/package.json
COPY mfe-mp/package.json mfe-mp/package.json
COPY mfe-verwaltungsakt/package.json mfe-verwaltungsakt/package.json
COPY mfe-vp/package.json mfe-vp/package.json
COPY mfe-ws/package.json mfe-ws/package.json
COPY mfe1/package.json mfe1/package.json
COPY mfe-ewm/package.json mfe-ewm/package.json


# Install dependencies for all workspaces
RUN npm ci

# Copy full source code
COPY . .

# Replace .env.production with .env.deployment for deployment build
COPY shell/.env.deployment shell/.env.production

# Build shared first (produces dist/index.js and dist/style.css)
RUN npm run build:shared

RUN ls -la shared/dist/

# Build all microfrontends in parallel
RUN npm run build:release --workspace=mfe-fp & \
    npm run build:injector --workspace=mfe-fp & \
    npm run build:release --workspace=mfe-kp & \
    npm run build:injector --workspace=mfe-kp & \
    npm run build:release --workspace=mfe-mp & \
    npm run build:injector --workspace=mfe-mp & \
    npm run build:release --workspace=mfe-verwaltungsakt & \
    npm run build:injector --workspace=mfe-verwaltungsakt & \
    npm run build:release --workspace=mfe-vp & \
    npm run build:injector --workspace=mfe-vp & \
    npm run build:release --workspace=mfe-ws & \
    npm run build:injector --workspace=mfe-ws & \
    npm run build:release --workspace=shell & \
    npm run build:injector --workspace=shell & \
    npm run build:release --workspace=mfe-ewm & \
    npm run build:injector --workspace=mfe-ewm & \
    wait

# Create non-root user
RUN useradd --uid 1001 --gid 0 --create-home appuser

USER 1001:0

# -------- Stage 2: Serve with Nginx --------
FROM nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged:1.29-alpine

# Copy built shell from builder stage
COPY --from=builder /app/shell/dist /usr/share/nginx/html

# Copy built microfrontends to their respective directories
COPY --from=builder /app/mfe-fp/dist /usr/share/nginx/html/mfe-fp
COPY --from=builder /app/mfe-kp/dist /usr/share/nginx/html/mfe-kp
COPY --from=builder /app/mfe-mp/dist /usr/share/nginx/html/mfe-mp
COPY --from=builder /app/mfe-verwaltungsakt/dist /usr/share/nginx/html/mfe-verwaltungsakt
COPY --from=builder /app/mfe-vp/dist /usr/share/nginx/html/mfe-vp
COPY --from=builder /app/mfe-ws/dist /usr/share/nginx/html/mfe-ws
COPY --from=builder /app/mfe-ewm/dist /usr/share/nginx/html/mfe-ewm


# Copy built microfrontends to their respective directories
COPY --from=builder /app/mfe-fp/dist-injector /usr/share/nginx/html/mfe-fp-injector
COPY --from=builder /app/mfe-kp/dist-injector /usr/share/nginx/html/mfe-kp-injector
COPY --from=builder /app/mfe-mp/dist-injector /usr/share/nginx/html/mfe-mp-injector
COPY --from=builder /app/mfe-verwaltungsakt/dist-injector /usr/share/nginx/html/mfe-verwaltungsakt-injector
COPY --from=builder /app/mfe-vp/dist-injector /usr/share/nginx/html/mfe-vp-injector
COPY --from=builder /app/mfe-ws/dist-injector /usr/share/nginx/html/mfe-ws-injector
COPY --from=builder /app/mfe-ewm/dist-injector /usr/share/nginx/html/mfe-ewm-injector


# Copy custom nginx configuration

COPY nginx-config/00-map-hash.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/00-map-hash.conf
COPY nginx-config/default.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
COPY nginx-config/cors-map.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/cors-map.conf
COPY nginx-config/cors-headers.conf /etc/nginx/snippets/cors-headers.conf


# Copy the environment injection script
COPY docker-entrypoint.sh /docker-entrypoint.sh

# Ensure the script is executable
USER root
RUN chmod +x /docker-entrypoint.sh
USER nginx

EXPOSE 8080

ENTRYPOINT ["/docker-entrypoint.sh"]
